consequence.statement: Environments upgrading to 1.17.0 gain the new `cilium_operator_unmanaged_pods` metric; the upgrade notes state only its addition and mention no impact on existing configuration, resources, or behavior.

assertion.statement: Cilium 1.17.0 adds a new metric, `cilium_operator_unmanaged_pods`, listed under "Added Metrics" in the 1.17 upgrade notes.
